q: The Arzelà–Ascoli theorem characterizes compact subsets of C(K) (continuous functions on a compact metric space K) as sets that are:
exp: Arzelà–Ascoli: a subset of C(K) is relatively compact iff it is uniformly bounded (|f(x)|≤M for all f, x) and equicontinuous (for each ε, one δ works for all functions in the set).
